name: Sherlock Research
_checkout: Checkout links. The Standard Report uses each industry's Payhip link in src/data/catalog.json. Set 'all', 'city' and 'quarterly' to a Payhip (or Stripe Payment Link) URL when those products exist; while a link is empty, its buy button opens a prefilled order email. Stripe links also receive the plan, industry and metro as client_reference_id; Payhip ignores extra parameters. 'payhipDirectCheckout' sends buyers straight to Payhip's checkout (payhip.com/buy?link=KEY) instead of the product page.
_samplePdf: Path to the free sample PDF inside sherlock-research/ (for example assets/sherlock-landscaping-sample.pdf). Empty means the sample is requested by email.
_cloudflareAnalyticsToken: Cloudflare Web Analytics site token (Cloudflare dashboard > Web Analytics). The privacy policy says the site uses it. Leave empty if Cloudflare Pages injects the beacon automatically.
_flipbookEmbed: HTML for an interactive flipbook embed. Empty hides the Look Inside section on report pages.

homeReviews.title: Saved me $12K I was about to waste
homeReviews.text: I was about to drop $12K on a marketing agency to push residential pressure washing. The city-specific report showed me which zip codes actually pay for premium service and which were a dead end. Cancelled the agency, rerouted my crew, and our close rate doubled in 60 days.
homeReviews.cite: Caleb T., Owner, Bear Power Wash

homeReviews.title: Restructured our pricing in one weekend
homeReviews.text: We were stuck debating whether to push our premium epoxy line or stay competitive on price. The Sherlock report showed us exactly which buyer segments would pay more — and which would walk. Rebuilt our pricing tiers that weekend and our average ticket went up 23% in the first quarter.
homeReviews.cite: Amir L., Owner, Garage Floor Coating & Epoxy
